timestamp_evidence.interpretation: MP4/container PTS is available for inspected videos, but no sensor/hardware timestamp field was found.

source_synchronization_evidence.basis: Local source audit records official RGB-T video-pair evidence and an original-paper non-alignment statement; no hardware synchronization proof found in local audited sources.

limitations: This step validates sequence/frame-index pairing, not hardware-level synchronization.
MP4 container PTS is not treated as sensor timestamp.
RGB and IR bounding boxes are not numerically compared because sensor resolution/FOV/position can differ.
No image registration, feature matching, embeddings, or model training were performed.
